title: Psychic Terrain (move)
text:
Psychic Terrain (Japanese: サイコフィールド Psycho Field) is a non-damaging Psychic-type move introduced in Generation VII. It was TM91 in Pokémon Sword and Shield, and is TM138 in Pokémon Scarlet and Violet.

=== Generation VII ===
Psychic Terrain creates terrain that envelops the field for five turns and replaces the background environment and any other terrain that is already in effect. It has the following effects on Pokémon that are on the ground and not in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move.

It boosts the power of Psychic-types moves used by affected Pokémon by 50% (regardless of whether the target of the move is affected by the terrain).
Affected Pokémon become immune to opponents' moves with increased priority (including moves boosted by Prankster, Gale Wings, or Triage).
Moves that target all Pokémon (except Perish Song, Flower Shield, and Rototiller) cannot be blocked by Psychic Terrain even if they become priority moves.
Nature Power becomes Psychic.
Secret Power uses the animation of Confusion and may lower its target's Speed.
Camouflage causes the user to become Psychic-type.
When a Pokémon with the Ability Psychic Surge enters battle, Psychic Terrain is automatically created. Upon successfully causing damage, Genesis Supernova creates Psychic Terrain on the field.
If the user is holding a Terrain Extender, Psychic Terrain's duration is increased to eight turns. If a Pokémon is holding an Psychic Seed while Psychic Terrain is active, it consumes the item and its Special Defense is increased by one stage (even if it is not otherwise affected by the terrain).
Splintered Stormshards removes Psychic Terrain from the field.
If powered up by a Psychium Z into Z-Psychic Terrain, the user's Special Attack stat rises by one stage.

=== Generation VIII onwards ===
Psychic Terrain now: 

Boosts the power of Psychic-type moves used by affected Pokémon by 30% instead of the previous 50%.
Boosts the power of Expanding Force by 1.5× and causes it to hit both opposing Pokémon in a Double Battle.
Changes Terrain Pulse's type to Psychic and doubles its base power from 50 to 100.
Changes a Pokémon's type to Psychic if it has the Ability Mimicry.
Psychic Terrain is automatically created when Max Mindstorm is used. Defog, G-Max Wind Rage, Steel Roller and Ice Spinner remove Psychic Terrain or any other terrain upon being used. Steel Roller also fails if Psychic Terrain or other terrains are absent.

==== Pokémon Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl ====
Psychic Terrain cannot be selected in a battle.
